indications.name: Dermatomyositis in adult patients
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-20: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Lisraya (brepocitinib) tablets for the treatment of dermatomyositis in adult patients.

pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The efficacy of LISRAYA in the treatment of dermatomyositis in adults was assessed in a Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, multicenter, placebo-controlled trial in 241 adult patients with dermatomyositis (Trial DM; NCT05437263).
